name: Shiva-Vishnu Temple
history: The Shiva-Vishnu Temple in Livermore is the largest Hindu temple in the region, built in grand South Indian style with separate sanctums for Shiva and Vishnu alongside shrines for Durga, Ganesha, Venkateswara, Karthikeya, Ayyappa and more. Run by the Hindu Community and Cultural Center, it is the Bay Area’s anchor for major festivals — especially Navarathri, when it hosts a full ten-day Durga Pooja program.

festivals.name: Durga Pooja Celebrations
festivals.details: Ten-day Navarathri program including Mata Ki Chowki (Oct 16, 6–8 PM), Kanaka Durga Kumkumarchana (Oct 16, 6 PM), Saraswati Puja (Oct 16, 6:30 PM), Bathukamma cultural celebration (Oct 18, 4 PM) and Navaratri Garba (Oct 25, 5–8 PM).

howToReach: Off I-580 in Livermore — take the Vasco Rd / Northfront Rd exits and follow Arrowhead Ave. Ample free parking on site; arrive early on festival days.
metaDescription: Shiva-Vishnu Temple, Livermore CA — 4.8★ (~4,800 reviews). The Bay Area’s largest Hindu temple. Durga Pooja Oct 11–20, 2026. Timings, festivals, directions.

name: BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir
history: A traditionally hand-carved stone mandir in the BAPS Swaminarayan tradition, the Milpitas mandir is both a place of worship and an architectural landmark. Daily aartis (7:00 AM and 6:30 PM) anchor its rhythm, and it celebrates Diwali/Annakut, Janmashtami, Holi and other festivals with grandeur.

festivals.name: Diwali & Annakut
festivals.details: The mandir’s grandest celebration — fireworks of devotion with annakut (mountain of food offering). Check baps.org/SanJose for timings.

festivals.name: Janmashtami
festivals.details: Birth of Lord Krishna celebrated with midnight aarti and cultural programs.

howToReach: In Milpitas near the I-880 / CA-237 interchange, off California Circle. Large on-site parking lot.
metaDescription: BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Milpitas CA — 4.8★ (~1,040 reviews). Hand-carved stone mandir. Daily aartis, Diwali & Janmashtami celebrations. Timings & directions.

name: Shri Krishna Vrundavana
history: A traditional Udupi-style Krishna temple in the heart of San Jose, home to Shri Raghavendra Swamy Mruttika Brundavana as well. Devotees love its golden mandapam, devotional poojas, prasadam after the noon pooja, and regular bhajans and cultural programs. Street parking in the neighborhood can be tight.

festivals.name: Janmashtami
festivals.details: Krishna’s birth celebrated with special alankaram, bhajans and midnight pooja.

howToReach: On Sunol St near downtown San Jose, minutes off I-280. Street parking — arrive early on festival days.
metaDescription: Shri Krishna Vrundavana, San Jose CA — 4.8★ (~850 reviews). Traditional Udupi Krishna temple with golden mandapam. Timings, festivals & directions.

name: Fremont Hindu Temple (Vedic Dharma Samaj)
history: Serving the Bay Area Hindu community since 1985, the Vedic Dharma Samaj (Fremont Hindu Temple) is one of the oldest Hindu temples in the region. Its campus pairs a traditional temple with a social hall, library and community kitchen that serves devotees daily. Sundays feature bhajans, pravachan and priti bhoj; Navarathri brings special Devi poojas and Garba nights.

festivals.name: Devi Navarathri
festivals.details: Special Devi poojas through Navarathri plus Navratri Garba evenings. The temple is especially vibrant during Navratri — arrive early for parking.

festivals.name: Diwali, Holi, Ganesh Utsav, Ram Navami, Maha Shivaratri
festivals.details: All major Hindu festivals celebrated with poojas and community meals.

howToReach: On Delaware Dr in central Fremont, minutes off I-880. Large lot; limited during festivals.
metaDescription: Fremont Hindu Temple (Vedic Dharma Samaj) — 4.7★ (~694 reviews). Serving the Bay Area since 1985. Devi Navarathri poojas & Garba. Timings & directions.

name: Shirdi Sai Parivaar
history: Started in 2001 as a small group of Sai devotees meeting for Thursday bhajans, Shirdi Sai Parivaar has grown to 10,000+ Saibandhus across the Bay Area. The Milpitas center houses a marble Sai Baba murti, Dwarkamai and a meditation hall, with daily aartis (Kakad 5 AM, Morning 8 AM, Madhyan 12 PM, Dhoop 6:30 PM, Shej 10 PM). Thursdays draw the biggest crowds; free prasadam is served on Thursdays.

festivals.name: Guru Purnima & Sai Baba festivals
festivals.details: Special abhishekams, bhajans and community meals on Sai festivals. See shirdisaiparivaar.org for the calendar.

howToReach: On California Circle in Milpitas, near I-880/CA-237. Plenty of on-site parking.
metaDescription: Shirdi Sai Parivaar, Milpitas CA — 4.8★ (~683 reviews). Large Sai Baba temple with daily aartis & meditation hall. Timings & directions.

name: Sri Satya Narayana Swamy Devasthanam
history: Run by VEDA (Vedic Education and Devotional Academy) since 2007 and in its permanent Milpitas building since 2010, this devasthanam is dedicated to Lord Satya Narayana with shrines for Shiva and Ganesha. Known for group Satyanarayana Vratams every full-moon day, beautiful sculptures, and a warm, welcoming priest — plus a spacious kalyana mandapam used for weddings.

festivals.name: Satyanarayana Vratam
festivals.details: Group vratam conducted monthly on pournami. All major Hindu festivals celebrated with enthusiasm.

howToReach: On Los Coches St in Milpitas, off CA-237. Parking can be limited during festivals.
metaDescription: Sri Satya Narayana Swamy Devasthanam, Milpitas CA — 4.8★ (~560 reviews). Full-moon Satyanarayana Vratams. Timings & directions.

name: Sunnyvale Hindu Temple & Community Center
history: Established in 1993 on several acres in Sunnyvale, this temple-community center houses murtis of all major deities sourced from India, each with its own sannidhi. Daily aartis (afternoon and 8 PM evening), a meditation room, satsang hall, prasadam hall and a cafeteria serving lunch and dinner make it a full spiritual-cultural hub. Hosts Ganesh Utsav, Holi, Diwali and year-round programs.

festivals.name: Navarathri
festivals.details: Special alankarams and poojas through Navarathri; Santoshi Ma pooja Fridays, Mata Ka Jagran first Friday monthly.

festivals.name: Ganesh Utsav, Holi, Diwali
festivals.details: Major festivals celebrated with cultural programs. See sunnyvale-hindutemple.org for the calendar.

howToReach: On Persian Dr in Sunnyvale, near US-101/Mathilda Ave. Large campus; festival parking fills early.
metaDescription: Sunnyvale Hindu Temple & Community Center — all major deities, daily aartis, cafeteria. Timings, festivals & directions.

name: Mandir Shreemaya Krishnadham
history: A Krishna temple serving the Alviso/North San Jose devotee community with regular poojas and cultural programs.
howToReach: In the Nortech business area of Alviso, North San Jose, off CA-237.
metaDescription: Mandir Shreemaya Krishnadham, San Jose (Alviso) CA — 4.7★ (419 reviews). Krishna temple. Directions & details.

name: Shiv Durga Temple
address: 3550 Flora Vista Ave, Santa Clara, CA 95051
history: The Shiv Durga Temple of the Bay Area serves the Hindu community with daily worship of Shiva and Durga — a natural destination during Navarathri. It offers the full range of Hindu religious services including poojas, havans and samskaras.

festivals.name: Navarathri
festivals.details: Nine nights dedicated to Durga with special poojas. See theshivdurgatemple.org for the daily schedule.

howToReach: On Flora Vista Ave in Santa Clara, near Lawrence Expy.
metaDescription: Shiv Durga Temple, Santa Clara CA — 4.7★ (~250 reviews). Shiva & Durga worship, Navarathri poojas. Timings & directions.

name: Balaji Matha Temple
history: A vibrant temple space for worship of Balaji (Venkateswara) and multiple Hindu deities, with special poojas and prasadam. Devotees praise its energy and diverse rituals.
howToReach: In San Jose — confirm the address on balajitemple.net before visiting.
metaDescription: Balaji Matha Temple, San Jose CA — 4.4★ (138 reviews). Balaji worship with special poojas & prasadam. Details & directions.

name: Shirdi Sai Darbar
history: A small, beloved Shirdi Sai Baba temple in Sunnyvale run as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. Devotees give it a perfect rating for its peaceful atmosphere and heartfelt worship.
howToReach: On San Geronimo Way in Sunnyvale, near US-101.
metaDescription: Shirdi Sai Darbar, Sunnyvale CA — 5.0★ (53 reviews). Peaceful Sai Baba temple, open daily 7 AM–9 PM. Directions.

name: Nithyanandeshwara Hindu Temple
history: A Shaivite temple in Milpitas with daily worship and a dedicated devotee base, associated with Kailasa San Jose.
howToReach: On Los Coches St in Milpitas, near the Satya Narayana Devasthanam.
metaDescription: Nithyanandeshwara Hindu Temple, Milpitas CA — 4.8★ (49 reviews). Shaivite temple with daily worship. Timings & directions.

name: Sri Krishna Balaram Temple
history: Run by the India Heritage Foundation in the ISKCON tradition, this Krishna-Balaram mandir hosts kirtans, Sunday programs and festival celebrations for the South Bay devotee community.

festivals.name: Janmashtami & Ratha Yatra
festivals.details: Signature ISKCON festivals with kirtan and processions. See kbmandir.org for schedules.

howToReach: On Reamwood Ave in Sunnyvale, near US-101.
metaDescription: Sri Krishna Balaram Temple (ISKCON), Sunnyvale CA. Kirtans, Sunday programs & Janmashtami. Timings & directions.

name: Vedanta Society of Northern California
history: Founded in 1900, the Vedanta Society of Northern California is the oldest Vedanta center in the West — more a spiritual lecture center in the Ramakrishna tradition than a conventional temple, but a landmark of Hinduism in America with Sunday lectures and meditation classes.
howToReach: On Vallejo St in Pacific Heights, San Francisco.
metaDescription: Vedanta Society of Northern California, San Francisco — founded 1900, the oldest Vedanta center in the West. Lectures & meditation.
